integrity: The proof derives an exact generation criterion from the semidirect-product law, proves the minimum generator number, classifies all three pair types, and counts degrees exactly. The packaged replay independently enumerates all minimum generating triples in two groups and checks explicit basis-completion witnesses in rank three.
scientific_limitations: The generalized-dihedral base is elementary abelian of odd prime exponent.
The theorem concerns the fixed minimum-size graph and does not classify the full independence graph.
The result settles the published divisibility question only for this infinite nonnilpotent family.
title: Minimum-generator independence graphs of elementary-abelian generalized dihedral groups
